change_requests_ops_check.name: change_requests_ops_check
change_requests_ops_check.value: case when "change_requests"."kind" = 'variables' then ("change_requests"."status" in ('open', 'approved')) = ("change_requests"."ops_enc" is not null) else "change_requests"."ops_enc" is null end

change_requests_four_eyes_check.name: change_requests_four_eyes_check
change_requests_four_eyes_check.value: "change_requests"."status" not in ('approved', 'applied') or ("change_requests"."decided_by_ref" is not null and "change_requests"."decided_by_ref" <> "change_requests"."author_ref")

cost_limits_check.name: cost_limits_check
cost_limits_check.value:
("cost_limits"."tag" is null or "cost_limits"."tag" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$')
        and "cost_limits"."max_monthly_delta" between 0 and 1e12
        and ("cost_limits"."warn_at" is null or "cost_limits"."warn_at" between 0 and "cost_limits"."max_monthly_delta")
        and "cost_limits"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'

pipeline_configs_include_check.name: pipeline_configs_include_check
pipeline_configs_include_check.value: ("pipeline_configs"."mode" in ('include', 'component')) = ("pipeline_configs"."include_project" is not null) and ("pipeline_configs"."include_ref" is null or "pipeline_configs"."include_project" is not null) and ("pipeline_configs"."mode" <> 'component' or "pipeline_configs"."include_ref" is not null)

policy_sets_text_check.name: policy_sets_text_check
policy_sets_text_check.value: length("policy_sets"."name") between 1 and 63 and length("policy_sets"."source") between 3 and 2000 and length("policy_sets"."ref") between 1 and 100 and length("policy_sets"."path") between 1 and 200 and length("policy_sets"."tag") between 1 and 32

run_stacks_policy_check.name: run_stacks_policy_check
run_stacks_policy_check.value:
("run_stacks"."policy_verdict" is null) = ("run_stacks"."policy_at" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."policy_verdict" is null) = ("run_stacks"."policy_denied" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."policy_verdict" is null) = ("run_stacks"."policy_warned" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."policy_verdict" is null or "run_stacks"."policy_verdict" in ('pass', 'warn', 'deny'))
        and coalesce(length("run_stacks"."policy_denied"::text), 0) <= 100000
        and coalesce(length("run_stacks"."policy_warned"::text), 0) <= 100000

run_stacks_cost_check.name: run_stacks_cost_check
run_stacks_cost_check.value:
("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_delta" is null) = ("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_total" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_delta" is null) = ("run_stacks"."cost_currency" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_delta" is null) = ("run_stacks"."cost_tool" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_delta" is null or (
          "run_stacks"."summarized_at" is not null
          and abs("run_stacks"."cost_monthly_delta") <= 1e12
          and "run_stacks"."cost_monthly_total" between 0 and 1e12
          and "run_stacks"."cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
          and "run_stacks"."cost_tool" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,39}$'))

run_stacks_summary_check.name: run_stacks_summary_check
run_stacks_summary_check.value:
("run_stacks"."plan_add" is null) = ("run_stacks"."plan_change" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."plan_add" is null) = ("run_stacks"."plan_destroy" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."plan_add" is null) = ("run_stacks"."plan_resources" is null)
        and ("run_stacks"."plan_add" is null) = ("run_stacks"."summarized_at" is null)
        and coalesce(least("run_stacks"."plan_add", "run_stacks"."plan_change", "run_stacks"."plan_destroy"), 0) >= 0
        and ("run_stacks"."plan_resources" is null or length("run_stacks"."plan_resources"::text) <= 4000000)

secret_findings_dismissal_check.name: secret_findings_dismissal_check
secret_findings_dismissal_check.value: ("secret_findings"."status" = 'dismissed') = ("secret_findings"."dismissed_reason" is not null and "secret_findings"."dismissed_by" is not null and "secret_findings"."dismissed_at" is not null) and ("secret_findings"."status" = 'dismissed' or ("secret_findings"."dismissed_reason" is null and "secret_findings"."dismissed_by" is null and "secret_findings"."dismissed_at" is null))

secret_leases_due_idx.name: secret_leases_due_idx
secret_leases_due_idx.where: "secret_leases"."revoked_at" is null and "secret_leases"."handle" is not null

user_identities_provider_check.name: user_identities_provider_check
user_identities_provider_check.value:
("user_identities"."provider" = 'gitlab' and "user_identities"."sso_provider_id" is null)
        or ("user_identities"."sso_provider_id" is not null and "user_identities"."provider" = 'sso:' || "user_identities"."sso_provider_id"::text)

stack_drift_found_check.name: stack_drift_found_check
stack_drift_found_check.value:
("stack_drift"."status" = 'unknown') = ("stack_drift"."checked_at" is null)
        and ("stack_drift"."status" = 'unknown') = ("stack_drift"."plan_add" is null)
        and ("stack_drift"."status" = 'unknown') = ("stack_drift"."plan_change" is null)
        and ("stack_drift"."status" = 'unknown') = ("stack_drift"."plan_destroy" is null)
        and ("stack_drift"."status" = 'drifted') = ("stack_drift"."since" is not null)
        and coalesce(least("stack_drift"."plan_add", "stack_drift"."plan_change", "stack_drift"."plan_destroy"), 0) >= 0
        and ("stack_drift"."status" <> 'drifted' or "stack_drift"."plan_add" + "stack_drift"."plan_change" + "stack_drift"."plan_destroy" > 0)
        and ("stack_drift"."status" <> 'clean' or "stack_drift"."plan_add" + "stack_drift"."plan_change" + "stack_drift"."plan_destroy" = 0)

variable_rotations_status_check.name: variable_rotations_status_check
variable_rotations_status_check.value:
"variable_rotations"."last_status" in ('never', 'ok', 'failing', 'pending_approval')
        and ("variable_rotations"."last_error" is null or "variable_rotations"."last_error" ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,40}$')
        and "variable_rotations"."attempts" >= 0

variable_rotations_handle_check.name: variable_rotations_handle_check
variable_rotations_handle_check.value:
("variable_rotations"."handle" is null or "variable_rotations"."handle" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/@=+-]{1,200}$')
        and ("variable_rotations"."previous_handle" is null or "variable_rotations"."previous_handle" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/@=+-]{1,200}$')
        and ("variable_rotations"."previous_handle" is null) = ("variable_rotations"."revoke_at" is null)

variables_project_key.name: variables_project_key
variables_project_key.where: "variables"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "variables"."environment_id" IS NULL AND "variables"."deleted_at" IS NULL

variables_environment_key.name: variables_environment_key
variables_environment_key.where: "variables"."environment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "variables"."deleted_at" IS NULL

variables_scope_check.name: variables_scope_check
variables_scope_check.value: "variables"."environment_id" IS NULL OR "variables"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

worker_pools_check.name: worker_pools_check
worker_pools_check.value:
"worker_pools"."name" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$' and char_length("worker_pools"."name") <= 63
        and cardinality("worker_pools"."tags") <= 10
        and string_to_array(array_to_string("worker_pools"."tags", ','), ',') = "worker_pools"."tags"
        and array_to_string("worker_pools"."tags", ',') ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}(,[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63})*$'
        and ("worker_pools"."image" is null or "worker_pools"."image" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/:-]{0,254}(@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})?$')
